ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across approximately 90-95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity white/grey pixels concentrated exclusively at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white and light-grey mottled blobs are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. The central region, from the peduncle to the trailing edge, consists of uniform low-intensity black pixels with negligible variance.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle of approximately 65-75 degrees and a vertical pixel depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible across the entire trailing edge. Small, sharp peaks are spaced at irregular intervals of approximately 10-25 pixels along the continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch outward, transitioning to a convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular and irregular pixel clusters are visible at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly the right tip, indicating localized surface disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmentation and scarring on the distal tips of both lobes; highly irregular and jagged serration pattern on the trailing edge compared to a smooth linear boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower central portion of the fluke and peduncle area is partially occluded by water splashes and the presence of several pinnipeds (sea lions) in the foreground.
